remarks: First time on the market in 38 years! Discover this well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial home in the desirable North Mianus neighborhood in Riverside. This home offers a versatile layout with comfortable living spaces, a bright kitchen, and a formal dining area, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The exterior features a well-designed deck that invites to entertain or relax overlooking a private, level backyard with versatile space for outdoor enjoyment in a serene setting. Ideally located near shops, transportation, and public schools. A timeless home in a truly convenient location!
